content: MoltenVK historically lacked/had bugs in headless surface support (VK_EXT_headless_surface request open since 2023) and has had reported issues with headless compute-only usage (system freeze/GPU timeout in one issue, black-image results from vkCmdCopyImage in another). Headless-without-any-surface (pure offscreen image + readback, no surface object at all) is the safer, better-supported path on MoltenVK than trying to use a headless *surface* extension.
